news.title: China women's football boss leaves eight months before World Cup
news.lede: Ante Milicic has left his post as coach of China's national women's team, the football association said on Friday, eight months before the World Cup." After friendly communication and consultations between both sides and considering Mr. Ante Milicic's family situation, the Chinese Football Association has decided he will no longer serve as head coach," the CFA said in a statement.

news.title: Asian Football Confederation boss says governing body is backing Infantino
news.lede: FILE PHOTO: Soccer Football - FIFA Under-20 Women's World Cup - Final - Spain v North Korea - Stadion Miejski LKS, Lodz, Poland - September 27, 2026 FIFA President Gianni Infantino reacts after Spain win the Under-20 Women's World Cup REUTERS/Kacper Pempel/File Photo. TOKYO, Oct 23 - Asian Football Confederation head Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al-Khalifa said on Friday the regional body would support Gianni Infantino's bid for reelection as FIFA president. Sheikh Salman had previously backed opposition to Infantino's failed plan to sell off the commercial rights to FIFA tournaments, including the World Cup, to private investors. He had joined with the presidents of UEFA and CONCACAF to pen an open letter calling the FIFA Forward Enterprise plan formulated by Infantino a "fundamental breach of trust".

news.title: Gianni Infantino endorsed by the Asian Football Confederation for another term as FIFA president
news.lede: Posted: Oct 23, 2026 / 12:39 AM EDT. Updated: Oct 23, 2026 / 12:47 AM EDT. TOKYO (AP) — The head of the Asian Football Confederation said Friday the body is endorsing Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president. The AFC has 47 member confederations.

news.title: FIFA opens bidding for 2030 and 2034 World Cup media rights covering US and Puerto Rico
news.lede: FIFA has commenced the bidding process for US media rights to the upcoming 2030 and 2034 World Cups. The bidding deadline is set for November 19, aiming to attract innovative broadcasting proposals. FIFA is also evaluating the future of hydration breaks introduced during the last World Cup due to their controversy. While the 2026 World Cup saw significant viewership, factors for 2034 remain under consideration.

news.title: Sydney FC coach blasts ‘nonsense’ as teen’s World Cup tug-of-war resolved
news.lede: Updated October 23, 2026 - 12.14am. First published October 22, 2026 - 9.23pm. Sydney FC coach Patrick Kisnorbo was left furious by the commentary around Akol Akon’s international availability after the club confirmed the young star would be released to play at the under-17s FIFA World Cup if selected. It was reported by a number of outlets on Wednesday the winger would not represent Australia next month as the Sky Blues had blocked him from doing so.
